result.title: Reflected Proximal Dynamics for Accelerated High-Accuracy Log-Concave Sampling
result.summary: We study sampling from $π(x)\propto\mathrm{e}^{-V(x)}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$, where $V$ is $α$-strongly convex and $β$-smooth with condition number $κ=β/α$. For this problem, the proximal sampler preserves the target exactly and recovers overdamped Langevin dynamics in the small-step limit, but its Gaussian resampling step discards directional information. Underdamped Langevin dynamics retains such information through momentum to accelerate exploration, motivating a proximal construction that combines target preservation with directional persistence. We introduce \textit{reflected proximal dynamics}, which combines proximal sampling with an exact reflection of the auxiliary variable, conditional kinetic motion, and controlled refreshment. We develop two realizations: a flux-resampled underdamped half-turn and a persistent-momentum quarter-turn. From a warm start with constant $χ^2$ divergence, both methods achieve total variation error $\varepsilon$ using $\widetilde O(\sqrtκd^{1/4})$ expected oracle queries. We further remove the supplied warm-start assumption by combining either sampler with existing posterior samplers in a proximal initialization stage with an optimized coarse step size. Accounting for both initialization and sampling yields $\widetilde O(κ^{6/7}d^{1/4})$ expected oracle queries. In both regimes, the dependence on the target accuracy $\varepsilon$ is $\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon)$, making reflected proximal dynamics a promising framework for accelerated high-accuracy log-concave sampling.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究强凸光滑对数凹分布的高精度采样，提出「reflected proximal dynamics」，用辅助变量的精确反射、条件动能运动与受控刷新来保留方向信息，在暖启动与自初始化两种设定下分别达到 Õ(√κ d^{1/4}) 与 Õ(κ^{6/7} d^{1/4}) 的期望 oracle 查询复杂度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「辅助状态保留方向信息、以刷新节奏控制更新」的构造及 polylog(1/ε) 的高精度加速，可能与 LVR 中扩散式 latent 状态的生成更新、信息坍缩与算力分配问题构成概念类比，可供核查而非直接迁移。
